What Is LMIA and How Does It Affect Your Canadian Work Permit? [2025 Update] If you’re planning to work in Canada or are an employer aiming to hire foreign talent, understanding the Labour Market Impact Assessment (LMIA) is critical. In 2025, the LMIA remains a foundational requirement under Canada’s Temporary Foreign Worker Program (TFWP), ensuring that the hiring of foreign nationals supports—not disrupts—the Canadian labour market.
